run_forward: run forward dynamics to compute position, velocity, actuation, and acceleration for a MuJoCo model
run_step: run a full simulation step by computing forward dynamics and advancing state with the selected integrator
run_step1: run the first phase of a two-phase simulation step before user input is applied
run_step2: run the second phase of a two-phase simulation step after user input is applied
run_euler: run semi-implicit Euler integration with optional implicit damping for a MuJoCo model
